title: My Stepson Forged Our Dissolution, Stole My Business, And Sent Me $3,900. So I Hired Him Back
description: After my stepson forged a dissolution to steal the half-million-dollar pen business I built with my late husband's life insurance, he sent me a $3,900 inkwell check as a final insult. I found the original notarized contract hidden in a 1920s Parker Duofold, proved the forgery, and now he works for me polishing nibs in a vest that says 'Written in Fraud.' #RevengeStory #JusticeServed #FountainPen
thumb_text: HE FORGED MY NAME, NOW HE POLISHES MY NIBS
pinned_comment: If my stepson forged my signature, stole my business, and mailed me a $3,900 'inkwell' check as a final insult, what would you have done? Share your story if you've ever been betrayed by family like this.
